decisions.reason: The schlager compilation CD fits the firm's existing reissue and catalog business, costs little to keep in a warehouse-backed catalog, and gives no signal of shortfall against aspiration in a growing industry, so management has no reason to start problemistic search.

The illustrated release series is a multi-model line built on the firm's core curation strengths and matches its plan to broaden formats, and with industry turnover growing, slack allows the firm to carry it while its results are still uncertain.
